class.name: OcgAdaptor3dCurveonsurface
class.brief_description: An interface between the services provided by a curve lying on a surface from the package Geom and those required of the curve by algorithms which use it. The curve is defined as a 2D curve from the Geom2d package, in the parametric space of the surface.
class.description: ! An interface between the services provided by a curve ! lying on a surface from the package Geom and those ! required of the curve by algorithms which use it. The ! curve is defined as a 2D curve from the Geom2d ! package, in the parametric space of the surface.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a CurveOnSurface from the 2d curve <C> and the surface <S>.

method.name: NbIntervals
method.description: Returns the number of intervals for continuity <S>. May be one if Continuity(me) >= <S>

method.name: Intervals
method.description: Stores in <T> the parameters bounding the intervals of continuity <S>.

method.name: Trim
method.description: Returns a curve equivalent of <me> between parameters <First> and <Last>. <Tol> is used to test for 3d points confusion. If <First> >= <Last>

method.name: Value
method.description: Computes the point of parameter U on the curve.

method.name: D0
method.description: Computes the point of parameter U on the curve.

method.name: D1
method.description: Computes the point of parameter U on the curve with its first derivative. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not C1.

method.name: D2
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U, the first and second derivatives V1 and V2. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not C2.

method.name: D3
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U, the first, the second and the third derivative. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not C3.

method.name: DN
method.description: The returned vector gives the value of the derivative for the order of derivation N. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not CN. Raised if N < 1.

method.name: Resolution
method.description: Returns the parametric resolution corresponding to the real space resolution <R3d>.

method.name: GetType
method.description: Returns the type of the curve in the current interval : Line, Circle, Ellipse, Hyperbola, Parabola, BezierCurve, BSplineCurve, OtherCurve.
